title: Mem0 Hybrid Memory
motto: Mem0 (Chhikara et al., 2025) treats memory as three stores in parallel — vector for semantic similarity, KV for fast fact lookup, graph for entity-relationship reasoning. A scoring layer fuses the three on retrieval. This is the 2026 production standard for external memory.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Mem0 (Chhikara et al., 2025) treats memory as three stores in parallel — vector for semantic similarity, KV for fast fact lookup, graph for entity-relationship reasoning. A scoring layer fuses the three on retrieval. This is the 2026 production standard for external memory.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: One store is wrong for one of three query classes:

- **Semantic similarity** — "what did we discuss about agent drift last week?" Vector wins; KV and graph miss.
- **Fact lookup** — "what is the user's phone number?" KV wins; vector is wasteful, graph is overkill.
- **Relationship reasoning** — "which customers share the same billing entity?" Graph wins; vector and KV cannot answer.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Vector + graph memory for persistent agent recall.
